description: A float that will not fit in what is left of a page moves to the next one whole, and the band it excludes moves with it, so the paragraph after it wraps beside it there. Port-authored: the reference engine files the band against the page the float started on, so there is no reference behaviour worth porting.
visual_assertions: The filler fills most of page 1; the aside does not start on it.
The aside is drawn whole at the top right of page 2, inside the page margins.
The paragraph starts at the top left of page 2 and its first lines are narrowed to the left of the aside.
